scope: Static read-only inspection of the public official Mozilla extension package; no installed wallet profile, private key or extension storage accessed. Package was not executed or installed.
findings: The Wallet Standard single-transaction wrapper validates the supplied chain then sends only the transaction to signTransactionV2.
The injected request dispatcher forwards only the transaction to the background signing handler. Adding a network field to the exposed request is not an established fix.

The extension independently reads its own configured network; its simulation request includes that network cluster. Therefore dropping the standard chain field alone does not establish the cause of the mismatch warning.

The background sign-only handler passes returned bytes to a vendor RPC proxy with a sign-specific header before returning them. The proxy behavior was not exercised or established by this static inspection. This does not prove a network broadcast, but sign-without-broadcast compatibility remains unverified.
conclusion: Login and displayed devnet balances succeeded by owner report. Full browser partial-signing and settlement remain blocked by the reported network-mismatch prompt. No secure application workaround is established. Do not switch to mainnet or bypass the warning. Preserve/reconcile original attempts.
changes: UI feedback improvement only; no wallet adapter change, new SDK dependency, chain-message alteration, or security bypass.
